name: Alex Rivera
resumeText:
Alex Rivera
Senior engineer, real-time data

Streamline (Jan 2024 – Mar 2025)
Designed and built a distributed event streaming pipeline for operational metrics. Services consume Kafka topics, compute windowed aggregates with sub-second freshness, and serve a live board to operators. I owned ingestion, the aggregation jobs, and the delivery path. The system handled backfill, retries, and a schema registry. Stack was Kafka, TypeScript, ClickHouse, and Docker. This is the work I would walk into a design review.
